_comment: Files a user can be given a download link to. title is required - an entry with a null title is never offered. Descriptions are what the model matches against when deciding which form to hand over, so make them say what the form is FOR. Note .doc and .docx are NOT searchable (only .pdf, .txt and .md are ingested) but are still downloadable from here.
